Definition: Nimrah, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Nimrah = "limpid" or "pure"; 1) a place on the east of the Jordan, 10 miles (16 km) north of the Dead Sea and 3 miles (5 km) east of the Jordan
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
